root_cause.details: The parser fails to disable DOCTYPE declarations and external entity resolution, allowing XML External Entity attacks as noted in the CVE.

fix_intent.details: The patch configures the SAXReader to disallow DOCTYPE declarations and explicitly disables external general and parameter entity processing.

cwe.details: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

derived_fields.pattern.disproven_when: derived verification condition based on FI; not a claim about target code
